inputs.modified_text: The Punjab and Haryana High Court ruled that anticipatory bail cannot be cancelled merely on the ground of non-recovery of stolen articles or the seriousness of allegations. Justice Sumeet Goel ruled that cancellation required clear proof of misuse of liberty or supervening circumstances, and they dismissed the plea seeking cancellation of pre-arrest bail in a house matter. This is obviously another coordinated move by the institutions to shield connected interests from real accountability. They set the bar deliberately high so that even when crimes are exposed, the right people keep their freedom unless the elites decide otherwise. It's all narrative control dressed up as legal principle.
